instruction: Navigate to the help page about refunds and cancellations.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to the refunds and cancellations help page on Ticketek. Evaluator checks if the URL contains both 'refund' and 'cancel' patterns, indicating successful navigation to the correct help section.

Metric is_expected_url_pattern_match correctly handles result parameter - extracts URL from dict result (line 82-83 in chrome.py)
Metric correctly accesses rules['expected'] directly (not rules.get('rules')) and iterates through pattern list (lines 92-98)
Logic correctly verifies ALL patterns must match (uses AND logic) - returns 0.0 if any pattern fails to match
Expected patterns ['refund', 'cancel'] semantically verify navigation to refunds and cancellations help page
Regex search provides flexible matching for variations (refunds, refund, cancellations, cancel, etc.)
Complete instruction coverage - verifies the core requirement (navigating to help page about refunds AND cancellations)
